reply_text:
Checker passes the real quote and catches an invented quote and a made-up turn id. Running an R14 pilot:Good pilot: 11 bids, each quoting your exact words where you set how firmly to commit. Committing the kit and launching the other 22:㊥ (bidding on turns) The turn-bidding round is running now: the 22 R-nodes after the R14 pilot, four at a time. Each R-node bids on 300 operator turns with their patterns hidden. When it finishes I'll un-hide the patterns and work out, for each pattern, the spread of R-nodes its turns attracted. I'll collate the results and report back.

㊢ (how it's set up) Everything is in `futon0/analysis/audits/rnode-turn-bids/`, committed as `7c1471f`.
- **Sample:** the top 100 patterns by hits, three turns each, chosen at random with a fixed seed. Each turn is shown with the end of the agent message it answered (145 of the 300 have one).
- **Blinding:** turns have opaque ids T001–T300 and no pattern, and agents are told not to look the records up. The key is kept in a separate `key.json`.
- **Priming:** each node starts from the claims its agent wrote about its code in the first round. That saves re-reading the code.
- **What counts as a bid:** a turn in which you yourself do what the node does. A turn that only talks about the node doesn't count.
- **Bid contents:** each bid quotes your exact words and says in one sentence what they take in or produce in the node's terms. At most 30 bids per node.
- **Checker:** confirms every quote appears word for word in its turn. I checked that it catches an invented quote and a made-up turn id.

㊬ (R14 pilot) R14 (commitment temperature) made 11 bids, and they read right to me. Three examples:
- T027, "don't come back to me until it's done or there's a major issue": a firm commitment, with the one condition for reopening it.
- T238, "take that as written for now, and we can always adjust later": a commitment held loosely.
- T273, "j7 stay off (but come back to this later)…": four candidates, each given its own level of commitment.

The first round turned up nothing like this from code.

㊟ (a caution on the counts) Three turns per pattern is thin. A pattern's spread over R-nodes will be suggestive, not measured. The stage-level picture pools 300 turns, so it will be firmer. It shows whether the nodes' bids stay within each pattern's stage label.

㊢ (tracking) The run is `bg-1790896388741-30` and the park is `park-3219a9f3-…`. kimi-2's forensic extension is still running under its own park.
